customManagers.description: The k6 openapi generator is pinned in the generator script, not in a lockfile, so no language manager sees it

packageRules.description: A bump here carries stale asset digests, which only a human can refresh, so it must not automerge
prBodyNotes: The four `SHA256=` constants in `scripts/generate-from-openapi.sh` still belong to the previous version and this pull request cannot compute the new ones. Refresh all four before merging, or `yarn generate-clients` stops at a checksum mismatch:
